APPROVE
The patch moves the per-file and top-level logic into helpers without changing behaviour: the iterator is consumed immediately by `AddRange`, so ordering and timing are the same, and the `top` pattern variable is still definitely assigned. That leaves the original method well under 15, and it should build, assuming the helpers it calls (`WorkflowJobs`, `JobTokenUse`, `JudgedWriteGrants`, `PermissionsBlock`, and so on) are static members, which isn't visible in the diff.
